description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DateTimeRangeTrait' for handling date-time range display and configuration in Drupal, including methods for rendering date ranges with ISO attributes, generating settings forms, and providing display options.

methods.name: dateTimeRangeDefaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for date-time range display, including 'from_to' option and separator.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for date range display based on field items and language code.

methods.name: dateTimeRangeSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds a configuration form for date-time range display options.

methods.name: dateTimeRangeSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current date-time range settings.

methods.name: getFromToOptions
methods.description: Returns available options for 'from_to' display setting.

methods.name: startDateIsDisplayed
methods.description: Determines if the start date should be displayed based on settings.

methods.name: endDateIsDisplayed
methods.description: Determines if the end date should be displayed based on settings.

methods.name: renderStartEnd
methods.description: Creates a render array for start and end dates.

methods.name: renderStartEndWithIsoAttribute
methods.description: Creates a render array for start and end dates with ISO attributes.
